lucy: Quick sync — finalizing release notes and internal blurb for Thursday's rollout. Change window: Thu 2026-04-09 23:00-00:30 PT. Need copy + oncall roster by 18:00 PT.
noah: can we keep the user-facing blurb short? remove the DB migration details; add 'minor schema change, backwards compatible'.
sree: oncall: anna nights Thu-Fri, i'll be primary for rollback ops. ops-lead is backup. Add escalation step to run `rb --to v5.3.2` if canary fails.
lucy: thanks. draft internal blurb pasted below — plz review.

lucy:
"Internal: Rolling out inference routing optimizer v5.4.0. Expected impact: reduced p99 latency for multisentence prompts. Change window Thu 11pm PT; canary 10% for 15m. If error-rate >2% over 5m or latency regressions observed, we will rollback to v5.3.2. Oncall: anna (primary), ops-lead (secondary)."

noah: LGTM but reword 'inference routing optimizer' -> 'request routing optimizer' to be clearer.
anna: ack, I'll monitor and confirm watches. Please add my pager contact: pager: +1-555-0187.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: 2026-04-10T06:00:00Z. Canary: 10% for 15m. Health checks: latency_p50, latency_p99, error_rate. Rollback triggers: error_rate > 2% (5m), p99 increase > 30% (10m).

sree: ops playbook snippet for rollback, add to thread:
```
# rollback quick
rb start v5.3.2 --force
notify --channel eng-oncall "Rollback started: v5.3.2"
monitor health 10m
```

lucy: perfect. i'll update the internal announce and schedule the short digest. final ask: who can sign off copy at 17:45? @noah?
noah: i can sign off at 17:45. :thumbsup:
lucy: thanks — i'll post the internal announce at 18:00 and pin this thread.
